subject.title: feat(sessions): add local timezone prefix to archive filenames

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the local-date-prefix plus UTC-suffix archive basename contract for configured users once QMD compatibility and proof gaps are fixed?
rationale: The change affects persisted session archive filenames and existing archive consumers, so maintainers need to confirm the product and upgrade contract rather than treating this as a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Adopt prefix after compatibility proof
options.body: Proceed with this direction only after QMD/memory consumers are updated, current-main conflicts are resolved, and real configured reset/delete proof is posted.

options.title: Accept narrower basename risk
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally land the reset/delete basename change while deferring QMD handling, but prefixed archive hits would have a known session-resolution gap.

options.title: Pause filename policy
options.body: Keep the linked feature request open and pause this PR until maintainers choose a different archive naming or display strategy.

recommendation.title: Adopt prefix after compatibility proof
recommendation.body: Proceed with this direction only after QMD/memory consumers are updated, current-main conflicts are resolved, and real configured reset/delete proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merge/refactor history touches the current archive and QMD helper surfaces, and this decision is about accepting a compatibility-sensitive filename contract.
